standard-dialogue.npc: I would prefer it if you didn't speak to me in such a manner. I'll have you know I'm an accomplished merchant.

steps.npc: Don't tell me to calm down! And don't call me 'junior'.
I'll have you know I am Farid Morrisane, son of Ali Morrisane, the world's greatest merchant!

steps.player: Then why are you here and not him?

steps.npc: My dad has given me the responsibility of expanding our business here.

steps.player: And you're up to the task? What a grown up boy you are! Mummy and daddy must be very pleased!

steps.npc: Look, [mate/darling] - I may be young, I may be short, but I'm a respected merchant around here and don't have time to deal with simpletons like you.

options.text: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?

steps.player: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?

steps.text: Grand Exchange: Ores and Bars opens

options.text: I best go and speak with someone more my height.

steps.player: I best go and speak with someone more my height.

steps.npc: Then I shall not stop you, [mister/miss]. I've too much work to do.
My father shall be so pleased.
Hmm. If divide by 20 and take off 50%...
I can make so much money here!
